data.narrative:
UFORCE is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Oleg Rogynskyy (CEO) and Oleksiy Honcharuk (co-founder, board chair, ex-PM of Ukraine). The company has raised $50M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies: 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

Stage-progression methodology was not applied. The stated post-money valuation of $1.0B+ exceeds 20x total capital raised, flagging the input as unreliable for extrapolation. Peer-median analysis, however, is applicable and grounded. Four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), Castelion ($1.0B, Series A), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A)—yield a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M–$805M, centered on $700M. This represents a 14x multiple on capital deployed, consistent with early-stage Defense & Security positioning. Key uncertainties include: (1) the wide dispersion across peer comps ($125M–$4.0B), reflecting heterogeneous business models and go-to-market trajectories within the sector; (2) reliance on a single applicable method, limiting triangulation robustness; and (3) company-specific execution risk relative to peers on product-market fit and customer traction.
